$description: Tango / Next Move — a paired identity for turning intent into a justified next action.
name: Tango

wordmark.note: SVG wordmarks use Rubik Bold outlines. UI and documents use Rubik. Regular and Bold font files and their SIL Open Font License are bundled in fonts/.

shape.markClearSpace: 18 units outside the visible silhouette at a 128-unit mark size

motion.principle: Intent establishes the movement; action follows one beat later. Keep state transitions legible and stop ornamental movement when reduced motion is enabled.

usage.onPaper: Prefer the ink monochrome mark for small or low-contrast uses. The paired mark may appear as a large decorative signature.
usage.colorMeaning: Solar highlights intention and action; lunar highlights observation and response. Both are necessary inputs, while direction stays with the user.
usage.seam: Keep the curved seam transparent. Preserve its width and geometry in all variants.
usage.texture: Keep the primary mark flat. Material references belong to photography and editorial surfaces, not the launcher icon.
